basic_info.description: Welcome to your new home at 2436 Jackson! This Victorian condo is all about the seamless blend of charm and modern living. With 2 light-filled bedrooms and 1 bathroom spread across an expansive open floor plan, this home feels both bright and spacious, and it is also very quiet. Location, location, location- this home is on the best block of town!! One of the standout features is that this home is ideally located at the intersection of Jackson and Fillmore, the best Pacific Heights location- to your left on the block is Blue Bottle Coffee Shop and to your right is Alta Plaza Park. This offers a great base. It's a sweet spot to settle in and enjoy the best San Francisco has to offer. Come check it out! You'll love the natural light that pours in, making it feel warm and inviting. A charming private front porch is ideal for morning coffee and afternoon relaxation basking in the setting sun. The shared garden offers a tranquil environment.  An in-unit washer and dryer and is a huge bonus. Leased Parking. This is the best of SF living.
